override.reason: The tooltip wraps: 'Defense Penetration: 10' / 'Magic Defense Penetration:' / '10'. The label and its value are on separate lines, so the value read as a bare '10' with no stat and the magic penetration was lost entirely. Confirmed by the project owner as Magic Defense Penetration +10. Left to the parser this would mean treating an orphaned number as belonging to the label above it, which is the same shape as a continuation clause ('Extra 1% per refine') but means something different -- so it is corrected here rather than guessed at.

'Full Shadow Card Set' is a set heading written without a colon, so the parser read the three lines under it as this card's own and the card claimed the whole set bonus on its own. Those lines are moved to the 'full-shadow-card' set, which needs all six Rank shadow cards compounded; what is left here is the card's own ATK/MATK.
